summary: Ran full regression pytest suite after router split + verified new safety-blocklist CRUD, marketplace OG thumbnail, and legacy /canon route removal. Frontend Playwright verified admin-only SafetyManager, marketplace thumbnail, anon vs admin nav, and dashboard variants. 26/28 backend tests pass; 2 tests fail because engine order changed during router split (regression vs. baseline). All frontend spot-checks pass.

critical.issue: ENGINE_ORDER in engines.py changed during router split. New order emits Governance/Economic/CanonVaultConnector/PublicCanonPage BEFORE NFTMint/Marketplace. Previous baseline (iteration_3) order was ...MemeBinding, MemeCoinBinder, NFTMint, Economic, Marketplace, Governance, CanonVaultConnector, PublicCanonPage, Webhook, ChartEngine, SSELiveTick. New order is ...MemeBinding, MemeCoinBinder, Governance, Economic, CanonVaultConnector, PublicCanonPage, NFTMint, Marketplace, Webhook, ChartEngine, SSELiveTick. This regresses test_root_v2 + test_engine_order_endpoint and, more importantly, NFTMint now runs AFTER PublicCanonPage, so any OG-page rendering that depends on token_id/chain_hash will lack them at render time. Fix: restore prior ordering in /app/backend/engines.py ENGINE_ORDER list.

action_items: Restore ENGINE_ORDER in /app/backend/engines.py to the pre-split ordering so test_root_v2 + test_engine_order_endpoint pass again AND NFTMint runs before PublicCanonPage (so token_id / chain_hash are available when the public canon page is generated).
critical_code_review_comments: engines.py ENGINE_ORDER regression (see above) — NFTMint now executes after PublicCanonPage.

GET /api/safety/blocklist is admin-only (returns 401 for anon). Task spec text implies it may have been intended as public read; if admin-only is deliberate, update spec, otherwise loosen the dep. Currently POST + DELETE + GET all require admin — consistent, but frontend Marketplace/OG doesn't need it so ok.
ControlDeck.load() uses Promise.all with no try/catch — if any of the 4 endpoints fails the whole panel silently stops updating; consider individual try/catch or Promise.allSettled.
Nav label says 'Control' but route is '/control-deck'. Minor UX mismatch — /control returns empty page (no 404 fallback). Consider adding a catch-all 404 route.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all spot-checked flows (SafetyManager CRUD, marketplace thumbnail, nav visibility, dashboard variants)

rca of the issue: During the server.py -> routers/ split, the ENGINE_ORDER list in /app/backend/engines.py lines 296-301 was reshuffled. The pre-split order (per iteration_3 baseline) placed NFTMint immediately after MemeCoinBinder and then Economic-Marketplace-Governance-CanonVaultConnector-PublicCanonPage-Webhook-ChartEngine-SSELiveTick. The new order places Governance/Economic/CanonVaultConnector/PublicCanonPage BEFORE NFTMint/Marketplace. Mitigation: swap the two slices back so ENGINE_ORDER ends with ...MemeBinding, MemeCoinBinder, NFTMint, Economic, Marketplace, Governance, CanonVaultConnector, PublicCanonPage, Webhook, ChartEngine, SSELiveTick. Reproduction: pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py::test_root_v2 backend/tests/backend_test.py::test_engine_order_endpoint.
